evaluation_path: The registered production backend, via recognize() -> accepted. Same preprocessing, per-class gates, NMS, cross-class suppression and plausibility checks as POST /api/panel/analyze. This is not the trainer's validator and the numbers will be lower than results.csv.

sweep.threshold_policy: decode_floor, unknown_floor and every per-class threshold set to 0.18; strictness 1.0. NMS, cross-class suppression and the geometric plausibility gate are at their production defaults.

best_operating_point.rationale: conf=0.18 maximises f1 (0.6576) among 6 measured point(s), at precision 0.5099, recall 0.9258, 9.4917 false positives and 0.7917 false negatives per image. Across the sweep, recall runs 0.926 -> 0.307 and precision 0.510 -> 0.887 as conf goes 0.18 -> 0.7. Measured through the deployed inference path — same preprocessing, gates, NMS and thresholds the API uses — so it predicts served behaviour rather than trainer-reported behaviour.
best_operating_point.how_to_apply: Set the components backend params to decode_floor=0.18, unknown_floor=0.18 (POST /api/ai/models/components/params). For better results than a uniform threshold, run `cli tune` to fit a per-class threshold at this operating point.
